q.en: Which phrase best rewrites "33% of respondents chose option A"?

options.en: Roughly a third of respondents chose option A.

options.en: Almost all respondents chose option A.
options.bn: Almost all respondents chose option A.

why.en: 33% is approximately one-third, so "roughly a third" is the accurate proportion phrase.
why.bn: 33% মানে প্রায় এক-তৃতীয়াংশ, তাই "roughly a third" সঠিক proportion phrase।

q.en: Which word signals contrast between two categories: "whereas" or "moreover"?
q.bn: দুটো category-র মধ্যে contrast বোঝাতে কোন word ব্যবহার হয়: "whereas" না "moreover"?

why.en: "Whereas" introduces a contrast between two things; "moreover" adds similar, supporting information.

q.en: Which sentence correctly combines proportion and change for two pie charts over time?
